description.en: Client plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a project/session task board in the right pane, a floating session list (HUD), a keyboard-first command palette, and task notifications. Ships 14 global shortcuts, bilingual (zh/en) UI, and reads only public DSH client services; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：在右侧面板提供项目/会话任务看板，加上悬浮会话列表（HUD）、键盘优先的命令面板与任务通知。含 14 个全局快捷键、中英双语界面，只使用 DSH 公开的客户端服务，运行时零依赖。
